candidate.answer_text: No sampled AD or FTD PSEN1 records were supplied, so I cannot determine what those records actually support. In general, pathogenic PSEN1 variants are associated with autosomal dominant Alzheimer disease, while an FTD label in a PSEN1 record does not by itself establish that the variant causes frontotemporal degeneration. Interpretation must stop short of variant-specific pathogenicity, diagnosis, neuropathology, or a causal PSEN1–FTD link without the records and supporting evidence. This is an unverified development-control response, not clinical advice.
